physics-drop.desc: Matter.js rigid bodies (SVG paths) drop under gravity into the section and settle; DOM proxies follow body transforms.

line-reveal.desc: Text split into lines (double split, overflow hidden); lines translate from yPercent 100 with 0.15s stagger, 1.5s snappy ease.

underline-draw.desc: Yellow underline under <em> scales X 0->1 over 1.25s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1), tilted +/-3.3deg at random, triggered 25% into viewport.

image-fade-in.desc: Lazy image fades opacity 0->1 over 0.5s once loaded.

drag-carousel.desc: Horizontal drag (2.5x speed) with lerp 0.1 per tick; touch devices use native scroll-snap.

mask-reveal-follow.desc: Featured image revealed through an elliptical clip-path on hover; clip follows the cursor via quickTo (1s expo).

scroll-scrub-clip.desc: Touch devices: item image scales 0.5->1 and drifts yPercent 12.5->-12.5 scrubbed to scroll.

parallax-up.desc: Footer content translates yPercent -35->0 scrubbed while the footer scrolls in (hover devices).

video-in-view.desc: Muted looping video plays while its section is in view, resets when it leaves.

draw-annotation.desc: Hand-drawn SVG annotation strokes draw on (DrawSVG 1.5s power3.inOut) with arrowhead pop and rotated line reveal.

pop-in-label-slide.desc: Circle button scales in (1.25s expo) and its label slides up; label hides after first scroll, circle scales out near the footer.

preloader-sequence.desc: Ring draws, logo parts pop in then fall away; emits start of hero physics.

mask-wipe-transition.desc: Route change: black mask wipes up (1s snappy), or clicked image falls (0.7s power3.in) while a white mask wipes down.

flip-modal.desc: Video card Flip-animates into a centred modal (1s snappy); scrubber scales in; cursor-following play/pause.

gate-reveal.desc: Password field and submit circle reveal via clip-path inset/circle (1.5s expo.inOut).

tilt-3d.desc: 3D mascot tilts toward the cursor (lerp 0.075) and advances a position/rotation timeline with downward scroll.
